thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High 5xx rate detected for model-serving cluster us-west-2 (severity: high). 30m window: 4.7% 5xx, increased timeouts. Paging oncall...

pagerduty-bot: Paging maria (oncall). 

maria (oncall): seeing alerts, joining. Any quick context?

alex (runtime): noticed spikes ~10:12 UTC. Error mix is SIGSEGV from model-runner and a bunch of `502` gateway errors. Tail logs show repeated crashes on pods running model-runner v2.3.1.

jordan (eng-sre): confirmed: metrics/runner/segfaults spiked from 0 to ~15/minute at 10:11. Latency p99 for text-gen rose from 380ms -> 1.8s. A few customers reported timeouts.

devon (infra): looks like some nodes started swapping and then oom-killer activity. dmesg snippet: 
```
[Mar 10 10:11:34] Out of memory: Killed process 31245 (model-runner) total-vm:1536220kB, anon-rss:1224368kB
[Mar 10 10:11:35] segfault at 7f5c... ip 00007f5c... sp 00007ffc... error 4 in model-runner[400000+1a000]
```

alex (runtime): stack traces point into kv_cache.c and the memcpy path during generation—likely a memory-growth edge when kv cache growth hits a particular sequence length. Repro is intermittent but correlated with long-history chat requests (seq > 4096).

maria (oncall): customers impacted? any enterprise tenants affected?

jordan (eng-sre): support reported elevated errors for tenant "AcmePay" on prod region us-west. Approx 3% of their requests got 5xx over last 30m. CS notified and posted a status update first.

maria (oncall): OK — I am initiating mitigation steps. Alex / Dev, I'll hand primary to you for triage, I'll coordinate comms and monitoring.

alex (runtime): mitigation plan (live):
1) Disable long-history routing for affected prod route (temporarily reject requests with total tokens > 4096 with a 413) — reduces seq length.
2) Enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant `redwood-4b-q` for low-latency paths to reduce memory pressure.
3) Drain and restart pods showing segfaults after collecting core dump. `kubectl annotate pod <pod> debugging=true && redwoodctl collect-core <pod>`
4) Increase replica count of model-runner in us-west by +30% for 20m to absorb load while we stabilize.

devon (infra): executing 4. Scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment/model-runner-usw2 --replicas=13` (from 10). Watch CPU/mem.

alex (runtime): pushing route config change to reject long-history now: `POST /routing/update {"route":"/gen","max_total_tokens":4096, "fallback":"redwood-4b-q"}` — applied.

jordan (eng-sre): also added a short-term autoscale trigger: if queue_length > 200 -> scale +2.

maria (oncall): comms: support has initial blurb live to affected tenants. I'll update status page with mitigation actions and suspected cause (runtime OOM/segfault under long-history workloads).

(devon) infra: core dumps collected from 3 pods. Putting them into /tmp/incident-1769994444/ and kicking off symbolizer.

alex (runtime): quick log excerpt from a crashed runner: 
```
E 10:11:35 model-runner[pid=31245] generation: memory growth detected: kv_cache_alloc=1.2G seq=4762
E 10:11:35 model-runner[pid=31245] fatal: unhandled SIGSEGV at 0x7ff... memcpy
```

alex (runtime): Temp mitigation looks good so far — 5xx rate dropped from 4.7% -> 0.9% in 8 minutes after fallback. p99 latency down to ~600ms.

maria (oncall): good. mark the incident P2 -> keeping high-watch. Jordan, keep monitoring error rate and notify if >1.5% again.

jordan (eng-sre): watching dashboards. Also opened a ticket for model-runner team to look at kv cache bounds + guardrails. Ticket: INF-7234.

alex (runtime): immediate follow-ups:
- Add defensive check to cap kv_cache growth per-request and return 413 when exceeded.
- Add fuzz test for long-history path and reproduce OOM locally.
- Consider switching to streaming flush for older KV segments.

devon (infra): observed one node with very high swap usage — cordoned and drained it: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-9-71 && kubectl drain ip-10-0-9-71 --ignore-daemonsets`

maria (oncall): drafting post-incident timeline for support and legal (AcmePay SLA watch). Any ETA on root cause?

alex (runtime): hypothesis: v2.3.1 introduced a corner-case where KV cache growth is unbounded for certain conversation patterns (combined long prompt + tool outputs). Root cause under investigation — likely a missing cap and an out-of-bounds memcpy when internal buffer grows. ETA for patch: hotfix PR in 90min if reproduce locally; otherwise revert to v2.2.8 in affected clusters.

jordan (eng-sre): started gradual revert plan: if we see another spike revert will be automated to v2.2.8 for us-west.

maria (oncall): current status for handoff: 
- Mitigations applied: route limit + fallback + scale + drain/cordon for bad node.
- Customer impact: reduced to ~0.6% 5xx overall; AcmePay impact reduced, CS notified.
- Data collected: core dumps, dmesg, model-runner logs collected at /enceladus/artifacts/1769994444/.
- Action items: runtime to produce patch or revert; infra to monitor node stability; eng-sre to watch error budget.

maria (oncall): I'm handing off primary oncall to jordan for the 10:45–12:45 UTC window. Jordan, please escalate to runtime if 5xx >1.5% again. I'll be available for comms but switching to follow mode. :white_check_mark:

jordan (eng-sre): taking over. I have escalation checklist. Adding notes to the incident channel and incident tracker.

alex (runtime): added quick mitigation PR to detect oversized kv_cache and return a controlled error; opening hotfix PR now: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821. If tests pass can ship to canary in ~45m.

devon (infra): node with swap shows high disk IO — investigating underlying kernel config. Might be a noisy roommate container; isolating now.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. Next steps: monitor for 1h, if stable we will move to postmortem. If not stable, we'll execute automated rollback. Jordan — you're primary. Alex / Devon stay on standby.

jordan (eng-sre): noted. Monitoring panels: errors, segfaults, p99, queue length. Will update every 15m or on change.

-- 10:40 UTC --

jordan (eng-sre): status update: 5xx now steady at 0.4% for 15m. No new segfaults. Rolling counts: segfaults/min -> 0.

maria (oncall): thanks. leaving a pinned summary for the followups: 
- INF-7234 runtime bug (kv cache growth) owner: alex
- INF-7235 infra: investigate high-swap node and kernel tuning (owner: devon)
- INF-7236 comms: customer follow-up and SLA review (owner: maria)

maria (oncall): handing final: I will close the paging if no regression in 60m. Otherwise escalate.

alex (runtime): copying notes into the PR and attaching core dumps. Will push hotfix if CI green.

devon (infra): leaving a recovery note: node ip-10-0-9-71 removed from pool; replaced by new node ip-10-0-9-96.

jordan (eng-sre): taking over fully. I'll file incident timeline and add to onboarding postmortem if fix merges.

-- 11:55 UTC --

jordan (eng-sre): Final check-in: 5xx at 0.2% for last hour. No further segfaults. Hotfix PR merged to canary and passed smoke. We'll schedule full rollout after additional tests. Closing active mitigation; leaving ticket open for root-cause postmortem.

maria (oncall): closing paging. Thanks team. :tada: 

(End of thread)
